description:
One reusable security workflow blocks pull requests and the release workflow on audit installation, data-source, or advisory failure.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The security workflow runs on pull requests and through `workflow_call`, installs a pinned `cargo-audit` with `--locked`, and executes `cargo audit -D warnings` plus both `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=info` commands against the committed locks.
- [hard] REQ-02: Installation, registry, database, and finding failures each propagate as a job failure; the workflow contains no `continue-on-error`, shell fallback, blanket ignore, or advisory allowlist.
- [hard] REQ-03: The shared workflow-contract checks assert that each of the three audit boundaries is a `needs` predecessor of every artifact-producing job in the release workflow, and that no path reaches publication while one of them fails.

## Notes

Blast radius: `.github/workflows/security-audit.yml` plus the assertions it declares to the shared workflow-contract harness. Gate-preset examples in `.jit/` remain repository-local configuration examples, not a substitute for the hosted check.
title: Enforce reusable blocking dependency audits
